title: What is TV Comic Book Reader for Roku?
content: TV Comic Book Reader lets you read comic books on your TV using your Roku device. Use your phone, tablet, or computer to choose PDFs, then view them comfortably on the big screen.

title: How do I start using TV Comic Book Reader?
content: Open TV Comic Book Reader on Roku, go to Connect, and follow the QR code or web address shown on your TV. From your phone, tablet, or computer, choose the PDF files you want to view.

title: What devices can I use to add PDFs?
content: You can use a phone, tablet, laptop, or desktop computer with a modern web browser.

title: Do my devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi network?
content: Yes. Your Roku device and the phone, tablet, or computer used to choose PDFs should be connected to the same local Wi-Fi network.

title: Do I need to install another app on my phone or computer?
content: No. You only need a web browser on your phone, tablet, or computer.

title: Can I choose more than one PDF?
content: Yes. You can select multiple PDF files and choose which one to open from the Document Library on Roku.

title: Can I drag and drop PDF files?
content: Yes, on browsers that support drag and drop. You can also use the file picker.

title: Can I choose a folder of PDFs?
content: Some browsers support selecting a folder. When available, you can choose a folder and TV Comic Book Reader will use the PDF files from that selection.

title: What happens if I select the same PDF more than once?
content: Duplicate selections are ignored so the same PDF is not added repeatedly.

title: Can I remove a selected PDF?
content: Yes. Remove the PDF from the browser page and the Roku Document Library will update.

title: What is the Document Library?
content: The Document Library shows the PDFs you selected in a TV-friendly grid. Use your Roku remote to choose a document and open it.

title: Why is the Document Library empty?
content: The library is empty when no PDFs have been selected. Go to Connect, open the web address shown on your TV, and choose one or more PDF files.

title: How do I open a PDF from the library?
content: Use the Roku remote D-pad to highlight a PDF, then press OK to open it.

title: Will a single selected PDF open automatically?
content: When only one PDF is selected, the app may open it automatically once it is ready. When multiple PDFs are selected, you can choose one from the Document Library.

title: How do I move between pages?
content: Use Left and Right on the Roku remote to move between pages. Press Back to leave the viewer and return to the Document Library.

title: How do I open reading options?
content: Press OK or Options while viewing a PDF to open the reading options menu.

title: What reading options are available?
content: Reading options can include zoom, fit mode, rotate, background color, night mode, search, thumbnails, go to page, and close.

title: Can I zoom in and out?
content: Yes. Use Zoom In and Zoom Out from the reading options menu.

title: Can I pan around a zoomed page?
content: Yes. When a page is zoomed in, use the Roku remote D-pad to move around the page.

title: Can I rotate a PDF page?
content: Yes. Use Rotate from the reading options menu to turn the page.

title: Can I change how the page fits the TV screen?
content: Yes. Use Fit Mode from the reading options menu to adjust how the page is displayed on your TV.

title: Can I jump to a specific page?
content: Yes. Use Go to Page from the reading options menu, enter a page number, and submit it.

title: Can I browse page thumbnails?
content: Yes. Use Thumbnails from the reading options menu to browse nearby pages and jump to the page you want.

title: Can I search inside a PDF?
content: Yes. Use Search from the reading options menu, enter the text you want to find, and choose a result to jump to that page.

title: Why does search take time in large PDFs?
content: Large PDFs can take longer to search. The app shows search progress and results as they become available.

title: What is Night Mode?
content: Night Mode changes the page appearance for easier reading in a dark room.

title: Can I change the page background color?
content: Yes. Use Background from the reading options menu to choose a different page background color.

title: Does the app remember my reading settings?
content: While you are using the app, it can remember reading preferences such as page position, zoom, rotation, fit mode, background color, and night mode.

title: Are password-protected PDFs supported?
content: Yes. If a PDF requires a password, enter it on the browser device when prompted.

title: Does TV Comic Book Reader save my PDF password?
content: No. PDF passwords are not saved by TV Comic Book Reader.

title: What kinds of PDFs are supported?
content: TV Comic Book Reader is designed to work with many common comic books, including portrait, landscape, text-based, image-heavy, and form-style PDFs.

title: What should I do if a PDF does not open?
content: Make sure the file is a valid PDF and try selecting it again. If the file is damaged, unsupported, or requires a password that was not entered correctly, it may not open.

title: Can I view PDFs with long file names?
content: Yes. Long PDF names are shortened on the TV screen so the library stays easy to read.

title: What happens if my phone or computer disconnects?
content: If the connection is interrupted, reconnect from the Connect screen and select your PDFs again if needed.

title: Why can't I connect from my browser?
content: Check that your Roku and browser device are on the same Wi-Fi network, the Roku app is open, and the web address was entered exactly as shown on the TV.

title: Can I use TV Comic Book Reader away from home?
content: TV Comic Book Reader is designed for local viewing when your Roku and browser device are on the same network.

title: Are my PDFs uploaded to a cloud service?
content: No. TV Comic Book Reader is designed for local viewing between your own devices. It does not provide cloud PDF storage or upload your PDF files to a cloud document account.

title: Does TV Comic Book Reader store my full PDF files on Roku?
content: No. TV Comic Book Reader is not designed to permanently store your full PDF files on the Roku device.

title: Does the app require an internet connection?
content: PDF viewing is designed to work over your local network. Internet access may be needed for Roku purchases, subscription validation, Help/FAQ, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, support links, or feedback links.

title: Can I use TV Comic Book Reader as cloud storage?
content: No. TV Comic Book Reader is a local PDF viewing app for Roku. It is not a cloud storage, backup, or document management service.

title: What information is shown in Settings?
content: Settings can show display information and temporary storage information, and it includes an option to clear temporary storage.

title: How do I clear temporary storage?
content: Open Settings and choose Clear Temporary Storage.

title: Will clearing temporary storage delete my original PDFs?
content: No. Clearing temporary storage only removes temporary app data on Roku. It does not delete the original PDF files from your phone, tablet, or computer.

title: What are the free access limits?
content: Free users may have a page-viewing limit per PDF. If the limit is reached, the app will show a Page Limit Reached message.

title: What does a subscription unlock?
content: A subscription unlocks continued viewing beyond the free page limit.

title: How do I subscribe?
content: Choose Subscribe from the app menu or from the Page Limit Reached message. The purchase is handled through Roku.

title: How do I manage my subscription?
content: Use Manage Subscription from the app when available, or manage your subscription through your Roku account or Roku device subscription settings.

title: Where can I read the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use?
content: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are available from the app menu.

title: Where can I get support?
content: Open Support & Feedback from the app menu and use the support option shown there.

title: Where can I send feedback or suggestions?
content: Open Support & Feedback from the app menu and use the feedback option shown there.

title: What information is shown on the About page?
content: The About page shows the TV Comic Book Reader app name, icon, tagline, and app details.
